components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A strong action control with a quiet lift on hover.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-ink, #1f2a24); color: var(--color-paper, #fbf8ef); padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgb(31 42 36 / 0.18); transition: transform 200ms, background-color 200ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--color-moss-dark, #3d5146); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(96 116 102 / 0.28); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quieter action control for supporting links.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid rgb(222 210 191 / 0.82); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(251 248 239 / 0.7); color: var(--color-ink, #1f2a24); padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 200ms, border-color 200ms, background-color 200ms; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: rgb(96 116 102 / 0.35); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(96 116 102 / 0.28); }

components.name: Moss Chip
components.description: Compact metadata with a calm tinted state.
components.css: .ds-chip-moss { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid rgb(96 116 102 / 0.2); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(96 116 102 / 0.1); color: var(--color-moss-dark, #3d5146); padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font: 500 0.75rem/1.25 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Tonal Surface
components.description: A softly layered content surface used when flat page structure is insufficient.
components.html:
Thoughtful systems

Clear structure, useful detail, and enough personality to feel authored.
components.css: .ds-surface { max-width: 24rem; border: 1px solid rgb(222 210 191 / 0.76); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.68), rgb(243 234 217 / 0.56)), rgb(251 248 239 / 0.88); color: var(--color-ink, #1f2a24); padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgb(57 45 32 / 0.12); } .ds-surface h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 1.875rem/1.25 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-surface p { margin: 1rem 0 0; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #526059); font: 400 1rem/1.75 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Editable Phrase Field
components.description: The signature inline contact field, identified by an underline rather than a box.
components.html: Cody Appleseed
components.css: .ds-editable-field { display: inline; margin: 0 0.06em 0 0.12em; padding-inline: 0.08em; border-radius: 0.08em; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #1f2a24); caret-color: var(--color-clay, #bd6f4c); text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-color: rgb(31 42 36 / 0.3); text-decoration-thickness: 0.03em; text-underline-offset: 0.14em; outline: none; transition: color 180ms, text-decoration-color 180ms; } .ds-editable-field:focus { text-decoration-color: var(--color-clay, #bd6f4c); text-decoration-thickness: 0.045em; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: A compact active-route treatment inside the floating navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-ink, #1f2a24); color: var(--color-paper, #fbf8ef); padding: 0.5rem 0.875rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: var(--color-moss-dark, #3d5146); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(96 116 102 / 0.28); }

narrative.overview: PortfolioV3 should feel like entering the personal space of a creative, thoughtful, fun, and professional builder. The system is warm and technical rather than corporate or futuristic, and it uses clear project storytelling, selected color, useful imagery, and authored motion to reveal both judgment and personality.
keyCharacteristics: Clear project storytelling with room for experimentation
Mostly flat layouts with selective ambient depth
Soft, confident, and quietly playful components
Intentional motion that contributes to the brand

rules.name: The Ink First Rule
rules.body: Deep Ink and Paper establish the visual hierarchy before accents are introduced.

rules.name: The Selected Color Rule
rules.body: Bright accents should appear as authored moments, not as a rainbow applied evenly across every component.

rules.name: The Scale Carries the Voice Rule
rules.body: Use clear changes in scale and weight to create hierarchy instead of repeated decorative labels.

rules.name: The Flat by Default Rule
rules.body: Start with spacing, color, and borders. Add shadow only when an element needs to float or respond.

dos: Do present projects as stories about problems, approaches, decisions, outcomes, and lessons.
Do let motion contribute to the identity through thoughtful, distinctive, and occasionally playful interactions.
Do keep keyboard access, visible focus states, readable contrast, semantic structure, and reduced-motion alternatives in normal implementation work.
donts: Don't build a generic developer portfolio template.
Don't use corporate stock-site aesthetics or impersonal consulting language.
Don't use overly dark cyberpunk styling, terminal cosplay, or technical decoration without purpose.
Don't use excessive animations, visual clutter, or novelty that competes with the work.
Don't treat pill-shaped controls, soft shadows, or any other current implementation pattern as mandatory.
